messages.subject: Installation issues with ggplot2 0.9.3
parts:
Hi everyone -

A number of people have mentioned seeing messages like this after updating to ggplot2 0.9.3:
  "The following `from` values were not present in `x`: col, color, pch, cex, lty, lwd, srt, adj, bg, fg, min, max ..."


The cause of these has something to do with the packages not getting properly updated by install.packages(). We haven't pinpointed exactly the circumstances where this happens, but most, if not all, cases happen under Windows. If you are experiencing these problems try the following:

- Start a clean R session, without ggplot2 or plyr loaded. When you run sessionInfo(), you shouldn't see either of these packages listed.
- Run install.packages(c("ggplot2", "gtable", "scales", "plyr"))
- Once they are installed, test it with: library(ggplot2); qplot(1:3, 1:3)

You hopefully will not see any of the error messages at this point.

For further information and discussion with others who have had these problems, please see:
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/13765835/unusual-error-in-all-ggplot2-commands
http://blog.rstudio.org/2012/12/06/ggplot2-plyr-release/ (in the comments)
https://github.com/hadley/plyr/issues/122

Good luck!
-Winston
